seed: Objects of type `reflection` under action ACTION3 with touching neighbours [player] show mixed outcomes: h,pixels,w,x,y x1, pixels,w,x,y x1. Find the condition in the before state that decides the outcome. Start from this kind of condition: the exact click position relative to the object, when the action is a click. Verify it against every transition before you keep it.

synth.notes:
Blocks of 3x3 on a 21x21 grid; walls = horizontal band row R + vertical strip col C; pieces = player block sets; selection shown as 0 in hole centres.
A5 cycles C -> R -> pieces (by min block) -> C; A1/A2 move C or the selected piece in x, A3/A4 move R or the piece in y; axes stop only at bounds, pieces stop at bounds and other pieces.
Reflections across R are visible gray; reflections across C or both axes are invisible erasers that count only in reflection ranking.
The frame is built from per-block sprite stacks (first solid top-down, else topmost hole fill) and split into 4-conn colour components ranked by bbox (x,y); targets merge when bbox gap <= 4.
The reflection A3 hypothesis is a red herring: there are no clicks, reflections are recomputed from pieces/axes. Unconfirmed: piece cycle order after pieces reorder.
